rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for the process or job of making films.

example.english: I’ve always wanted to learn cinematography.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng2 hok6 paak3 din6 jing2

rows.note: Use this when the focus is specifically on the camera work and visual craft of a film rather than film production as a whole.

example.english: The cinematography in this film is excellent, and the night scenes have a special atmosphere.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅電影攝影做得好出色，夜景特別有氣氛。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 ge3 din6 jing2 sip3 jing2 zou6 dak1 hou2 ceot1 sik1 je6 ging2 dak6 bit6 jau5 hei3 fan1
